connectedAccounts.unlinkFailed: Removing the sign-in method failed. Please try again.

errors.already_linked: A sign-in method of this type is already linked to your account.
errors.slot_occupied: A sign-in method of this type is already linked to your account.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Choose the primary color used throughout the app for this band.

storage.title: Storage used
storage.description: Total size of this band's uploaded files (banners, attachments, photos, logos, invoices).

shopify.title: Shopify app credentials
shopify.description: Connect Shopify to import complete paid orders, processing fees and payout data. The app needs read_orders and read_shopify_payments. Enter its Client ID, secret and store domain; the secret is stored securely and never shown in full after saving.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.helper: Your app's Client ID from the Shopify Dev Dashboard.
clientId.error: Invalid Client ID. It is at least 32 hexadecimal characters.

secret.label: App secret
secret.helper: Paste your app's client secret from the Shopify Dev Dashboard.
secret.invalidFormat: Invalid secret format. The app secret starts with "shpss_" followed by 32 hexadecimal characters.
secret.saveFailed: Failed to save the app secret. Please try again.

domain.label: Store domain
domain.description: Your myshopify.com domain — required to read orders, payment fees and payouts.
domain.error: Invalid domain. Use the form yourband.myshopify.com.

mollie.title: Send payment links through Mollie
mollie.description: Used to create payment links via Mollie. The key is stored securely and never shown in full after saving.
mollie.label: Mollie API key
mollie.helper: Paste your live or test key from the Mollie dashboard.
mollie.invalidFormat: Invalid key format. Keys must start with live_ or test_ followed by at least 25 alphanumeric characters.
mollie.saveFailed: Failed to save key. Please try again.

resend.title: Send emails through Resend
resend.description: Connect Resend for email delivery from your own domain from GigBuddy. The key is stored securely and never shown in full after saving.
resend.label: Resend API key
resend.helper: Use a sending-access key from Resend, restricted to your verified sending domain when possible.
resend.invalidFormat: Invalid key format. Resend API keys start with re_.
resend.saveFailed: Failed to save key. Please try again.

accounting.title: Accounting Settings
accounting.description: Default accounts used when creating invoices and purchases.
accounting.booksClosedThroughHelper: Nothing can be posted on or before this date. Leave empty to keep the books open.

errors.account_has_open_balance: This account still carries an open balance (unpaid bills, unsettled member debt, unpaid invoices, or an unsettled VAT balance). Settle it before changing the account.
errors.vat_control_account_conflict: An input or output VAT account cannot also be assigned to another accounting role.
errors.invalid_books_closed_through: Enter a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD) or clear the field.

chartOfAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts
chartOfAccounts.description: The accounts used to categorize financial transactions. Add sub-accounts or deactivate accounts you don't need.
chartOfAccounts.setCapitalizable: Allow capitalizing purchases to this asset account
chartOfAccounts.unsetCapitalizable: Stop offering this asset account on purchases
chartOfAccounts.inUse: Account is in use and cannot be modified.

bandsintown.title: Bandsintown
bandsintown.description: Connect Bandsintown to fetch your artist profile and import upcoming events as gigs.
bandsintown.label: Bandsintown API key (app_id)
bandsintown.helper: The app_id you registered with Bandsintown for API access.
bandsintown.invalidFormat: This doesn't look like a valid Bandsintown API key.

artistId.label: Artist ID
artistId.description: The ID of your Bandsintown artist page.
artistId.helper: Find it in your Bandsintown artist URL: bandsintown.com/a/<artist ID>.
artistId.invalidFormat: The artist ID is the number in your Bandsintown artist URL.

financialProfile.title: Financial profile
financialProfile.description: Your band's legal and financial identity: the name, address and identifiers that appear on the invoices you send. Your accountant and your customers rely on these being the registered details.
financialProfile.legalFormNoteHelper: Optional, for a form not in the list or an extra detail.
financialProfile.postalCountryHelper: The country on your address. Set the country your books are kept in under Accounting profile.

errors.unknown: Could not save the financial profile.
errors.invalid_tax_id: That VAT number does not match the format for your band's accounting country.
errors.invalid_kvk_number: That registration number does not match the format for your band's accounting country.

accountingProfile.title: Accounting profile
accountingProfile.description: The accounting rules this band's bookkeeping follows. Later reports, VAT workpapers and retention periods are derived from these answers, so they describe facts about the band rather than preferences.
accountingProfile.notApplicable: Not applicable — this band is not VAT registered.
accountingProfile.needsReview: These values were inherited when the accounting profile was introduced. Check them and confirm.
accountingProfile.nonEuroPending: This band's base currency is recorded but not yet applied: invoices, the UBL export and reports are still produced in euro. Multi-currency bookkeeping is not available yet.
accountingProfile.countryHelper: Changing this is only possible before any financial document exists and resets country-dependent accounting settings.
accountingProfile.baseCurrencyHelper: Derived from the accounting country and used for all bookkeeping, invoices and reports.

changeCountry.title: Change accounting country
changeCountry.warning: This is only possible before any invoice, purchase, journal, reimbursement, VAT return, merchandise sale or bank import exists. It resets VAT registration, filing settings, legal form, reporting framework, scheme enrolments and product VAT defaults. Stored identifiers must be valid for the new country.

accountingProfile.vatRegisteredHelper: A legal fact, not something we infer from turnover. Leave unconfirmed until you know.
accountingProfile.vatFilingFrequencyHelper: Copy the period the tax authority assigned you; do not guess.

vatFilingFrequencies.authority_assigned: As assigned by the tax authority

errors.unknown: Could not save the accounting profile.
errors.unavailable: The accounting profile could not be loaded.
errors.country_immutable: The accounting country is fixed when the band is created and cannot be changed here.
errors.profile_incomplete: Answer every field before confirming the profile.
errors.vat_fields_require_registration: Set Registered for VAT to yes before choosing a VAT basis or filing frequency.
errors.vat_fields_required_when_registered: A VAT-registered band needs a VAT basis and a filing frequency.
errors.invalid_financial_year_start: That day does not exist in the chosen month.
errors.accounting_country_has_financial_documen: The accounting country cannot be changed because financial documents already exist.
errors.tax_id_incompatible_vat_country: The stored VAT number is not valid for the selected country. Clear or replace it in the financial profile first.
errors.kvk_incompatible_vat_country: The stored registration number is not valid for the selected country. Clear or replace it in the financial profile first.
errors.filing_frequency_derived_from_scheme: The filing period follows the VAT scheme. Start or end a scheme below instead of setting this.
errors.invalid_scheme_code: Choose a scheme from the list.
errors.scheme_country_mismatch: That scheme does not belong to this band's accounting country.
errors.valid_to_before_valid_from: The last day cannot be before the first day.
errors.overlapping_enrolment: Another enrolment already covers those dates.
errors.scheme_requires_vat_registration: A band on a VAT scheme is still registered for VAT. Set Registered for VAT to yes first.
errors.enrolment_confirmed: A confirmed enrolment is retracted, not deleted, so the history stays intact.
errors.enrolment_referenced: Invoices or bills were issued during this period, so it cannot be removed.
errors.enrolment_voided: This enrolment has been retracted and can no longer be edited.

accountingProfile.defaultVatRateHelper: Pre-filled on new invoice lines. You can still change the rate per line.

vatScheme.title: VAT scheme
vatScheme.description: Which small-business or cross-border scheme this band is enrolled in, and between which dates. Changing this never changes an invoice you have already sent — those keep the VAT treatment they were issued with.
vatScheme.empty: No scheme recorded. This band charges and files VAT normally.
vatScheme.validFromHelper: The date the scheme started applying, as stated by the tax authority.
vatScheme.validToHelper: The last day the scheme applied — that day is still covered. Leave empty while the scheme is ongoing.
vatScheme.confirmationDateHelper: Optional: the date on the letter or notice confirming the enrolment.
vatScheme.destinationCountryHelper: The member state that granted the exemption. The cross-border scheme is recorded per destination.
vatScheme.frequencyFromScheme: Exempt: this band is on a VAT scheme, so it does not file periodic returns. End the scheme below to choose a filing period.
vatScheme.notImplemented: This scheme will be recorded, but suppressing VAT on invoices is currently only implemented for the Dutch KOR. Your invoices will keep charging VAT.
vatScheme.destinationOnlyNote: The cross-border scheme applies to sales into the destination country only. It does not change the VAT returns you file at home.
vatScheme.issuedUnaffected: Invoices you have already sent keep the VAT treatment they were issued with, so correcting these dates is safe.

directory.askHelp: Tell them who you are and what you play. The band's admins decide.
